name: Support agent
description: Answers a customer's support ticket from a help centre and an order lookup. TypeScript.

tasks.input: I bought the annual Business plan on order A-1042 three weeks ago and want my money back. Can I get a full refund?
We removed four seats yesterday. Do we get a credit for the rest of this billing cycle?
How do I export all of our workspace data, and how long is the download link valid?
Which identity providers work with single sign-on, and which plan do we need?
